text_block_list.text:
One day, as I was heading back to the 
trainer's office after a meeting—
(Thump! Thump!!)

When I rushed into the Trainer's office— 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi was happily scribbling 
away with her pen.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
An autograph board, an autograph board! An 
autograph, an autograph!! And then—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: The final touch is with a stamp!!
(BOOOM!)

After calming Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi down for 
the moment, I asked for the full details 
of what happened.
choice_data_list: A reply to a fan letter?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That's right! The "Tsuru-chan Fan Club"!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
They're always sending me words of 
encouragement and updates on how they're 
doing~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The other day... the girl who wrote to me 
about choosing her dream school passed her 
entrance exams with flying colors!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
They wrote that watching my run... gave 
them courageee~!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And someone playing adult league soccer 
sent a message saying, 'Watching you 
reignited my youth!' and things like that!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Every single letter... was so warm.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It gives me strength, making me feel like 
I have to do my best too!!

"I understand you're writing replies to 
your fans, and I think that's wonderful. 
However, what concerns me right now is—"
choice_data_list: What was that stamp from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: This is a thank-you!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
This is a thank-you for such a heartfelt 
letter! So I have to pour my whole heart 
into it, too!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So, with all my gratitude and strength... 
I stamp this seal down as hard as I can to 
give back!

I see. It seems a warm bond has blossomed 
between you and the fans. However... at 
this rate, your room won't be able to hold 
it all!
choice_data_list:
Let's move to a place where you can go all 
out!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I see, the training course! I can give it 
my all here!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
All right! Please make sure the autograph 
board doesn't blow away!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Heeere I goooo!!
(BOOOM!)

Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's stamp-filled replies 
were reportedly a huge hit with her fans.
